cause: MenuInputGuard considered the practice text layout modal but its joysticks were siblings outside that modal, so their mouse_filter became IGNORE. Touch input strength and rider displacement were zero.
fix: Reuse the complete level_0.tscn with LevelCatalog level 1 inside one modal host. No copied player/bull/pen logic. Existing level gets only familiarization exit/restart/presentation hooks.
caveats: A previous world test left a root loading curtain; touch fixture removes that curtain before testing the menu, matching the established joystick fixtures.
Website guide from 3.0.24 still shows retired separate practice; website was not changed.
